Ava: quick design question — noticed a quirky microinteraction on the console. When I tap primary buttons on slower emulated networks the visual press feedback is delayed ~150-200ms and sometimes we fire two toasts if the user double-taps. screenshot attached. is this expected? Sam: can repro on nightly. i think two things: (1) we rely on the CSS fade animation for the pressed state which defers pointer-events changes, and (2) there's no client-side debounce so double clicks enqueue two actions. Ava: ah ok. i didn't realize the pressed state used opacity transition. it feels sluggish on mobile. would prefer immediate visual down-state, then subtle release animation. Priya: agree with Ava. propose we do small UX + infra changes: debounce 250ms client-side for primary actions + coalesce identical toast messages for 1s window. also add metrics: `ui.button.press_start`, `ui.button.action_sent`, `ui.toast.shown`, `ui.toast.coalesced`. Sam: debounce is easy. coalescing toasts needs a small queue on the client. sample pseudo: ```js let toastQueue = new Map(); function showToast(key, msg){ if(toastQueue.has(key)) return; toastQueue.set(key, true); setTimeout(()=>{ toastQueue.delete(key); renderToast(msg); }, 1000); } ``` Mai: accessibility notes: make sure toast container uses `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"` so screenreaders don't spam on rapid toasts. buttons should toggle `aria-pressed` when applicable. also copy: we should prefer concise, consistent phrasing. options for save success: `Saved`, `Saved successfully`, `All changes saved`. my vote: `Saved` for inline actions, `All changes saved` for autosave banners. Ava: i like `Saved` for quick toasts — keeps motion short and copy scannable. for destructive actions maybe `Deleted` + undo. Liam: priority wise — this feels medium-high. affects perceived performance and accessibility. propose: fix immediate press state (design + css), add debounce (client), coalesce toasts (client), add metrics and a small canary rollout. estimate 3 dev days + 1 design day. Priya: i'll add the metrics/events to the telemetry board and create an experiment to track reduction in duplicate actions. also recommend adding a low-level flag `ui.microinteraction.experimental` so we can toggle coalescing by user segment. Sam: one small implementation detail — avoid blocking server idempotency changes. debounce is UX-only; but we should also ensure backend is idempotent for critical endpoints. i'll add a note in the PR template. Ava: copy task for docs/devex: update component library guidelines: "press feedback should be immediate; avoid multi-step opacity delays for primary buttons". i'll draft the blurb. ux-bot: :eyes: created follow-up issue #4281 (design: button microinteraction fixes) — assigned to @sam and @ava.
